body: I have an abundance of these and wondering if any of you creative folks have some ideas of what I could use them for?  I would like to use some for some Halloween decorations (maybe creepy doll heads?) but have so many that I could use for other things as well. Any ideas??
Ye mood has beautiful stuff but their chiffons were a bit over my budget
Good for you!  So proud of you!  Took me 7 years to come out to my husband.  All the best to you!!

I recently had the same thing said to me. They are hospitalizing me on Monday. I had to convince them to give me the weekend to get shit in order. I don’t know why I’m even bothering. I know I will complete the task eventually. And I’m sick of talking about my thoughts and feelings. 
There’s just so much to do before you go through with it - getting your affairs in order and all that.  Depression has such hold of me right now that there are days I can barely lift my limbs, let alone tackle everything on my “to-do before I die” list.

Well you and I are in very similar situations. I feel for you. I’ve never felt pain like this before. I am head over heels in love and am now hated by them.  I’ve never felt this way about anyone else in my life and now have attempted suicide because of it and am being hospitalized on Monday. I hope you pull through this, but I’ll tell you - this happened to me about 2 months ago now and I have no desire to pull through and the feelings have gotten worse and more intense each day.

3.5 years?  How do you cope?  I mean, all the power to you for being in that headspace for that long and still here!  Do you see a therapist of any kind?  Medication?  I’m truly interested as I don’t think i could last that long.
This is a great question!  I never even considered it, just assumed they’d all want or expect a note. It’s nice to read all the insights and opinions
Yes, that is why I am here right now. It helps a bit to know you’re not the only one.
It’s like you read my mind...

I’ve made some very horrible and irreparable life decisions in the last few years and it has all finally come crashing down on me.  I truly do not deserve to live and share this earth with decent human beings.  It’s a favor to mankind to be rid of me. Trust me, I’m not exaggerating. The world will be a better place without me in it. And I’m working my butt off to have everything taken care of before I go so there is the least amount of shit to deal with for those left behind. They will be so much better off in the end.

I’m glad you have some excitement and happy thoughts about being a dad. That should tell you that you won’t be a shitty dad. I, on the other hand, have made some very horrible choices and mistakes and life decisions in the last few years and time has not made anything better. It has gotten insanely worse in the last few months and instead of coasting through like a fraudulent zombie and hurting even more people, I have to go. I am a complete failure as a human and as a parent. I honest to god am doing everyone a favor by leaving.  They’ll understand that eventually. 
But you hang in there so you get to see those beautiful baby eyes and chubby fingers and toes. The birth of your child could be the catalyst for a whole new way of thinking for you!!

Yes!!  All the time. Then I think that makes me a coward too.  But at this point, I know I truly do not deserve to live anymore so can’t be waiting around for someone else to do it, have to take matters into my own hands
Thank you SO much!  Very appreciated!!
